packets.title: Freeze interaction, selector and copy contracts
packets.outcome: Record existing action entry points, data-rp hooks, mode/task/selection/save matrix and exact new EN/DE strings. Land required locale registration and any genuinely necessary shared presentation seam atomically before consumer packets. Do not add speculative orphan modules or dead CSS. Resolve U4 chooser decision and arbitrary-corner accessibility scope; unresolved conditional work remains blocked.
packets.guard: No behavioral rebuild. Preserve working Paste/history/root routes. This packet is the only default writer of root and aggregate files; later requests require serialized integrator ownership.

packets.title: Make the active mode unmistakable
packets.outcome: Implement labeled Plan/Renovate/Review and mode caption/semantic accent treatment using existing switching actions. Preserve keyboard radio navigation and stable breadcrumb/history placement. Expose mode cues that remain meaningful without color.
packets.guard: Do not change perspective persistence, Review snapshot or draft confirmation logic. No hardcoded color literals; reuse semantic variables.

packets.title: Consolidate compact navigation and stable panels
packets.outcome: Map Property/Layers to existing expandable navigation and entity lists; keep Details identity, resizable wide panels and clear narrow return. Preserve input/caret/focus through reflow and existing width thresholds. Make Fit/reveal reachable without automatically moving camera.
packets.guard: Do not add a navigation store, hide keyboard lists, change supported mobile scope or infer actual CSS geometry from raster pixels.

packets.title: Put common Room edits first
packets.outcome: Reorder Plan Room identity, area, name and eligible size route before advanced shape/rotation. Show one clear Renovate-this-element route instead of the full renovation inventory in Plan. Keep the normal no-selection/multi/locked bodies truthful.
packets.guard: Do not invent universal width/depth for irregular/rotated rooms, auto-follow walls, new renaming commands or permanent rotation handles.

packets.title: Focus Renovate on work and information
packets.outcome: Create the selected hybrid's Existing/Planned/Work hierarchy, primary eligible Add work and concise linked-content routes. Keep the selected identity and explicit Edit layout route. Reuse existing commands/target eligibility including room-less elements.
packets.guard: Do not modify costs, work schemas, source-of-truth ownership or Review behavior. Do not display zero where unknown.

packets.title: Clarify starting and finishing Room creation
packets.outcome: Preserve three starting routes with reference optional. Put name and width/depth before advanced shape controls. Keep valid/invalid input, last-valid preview labeling and synchronized Create/Cancel availability. Keep adding remains explicit.
packets.guard: Do not change draft-store/parser or persistence semantics. Select is not pressed while creation is active. Escape and Cancel remain different.

packets.title: Make reference source preparation approachable
packets.outcome: Make existing vault-file suggestions the primary selection route with filename/preview context. Keep exact path, PDF page, rotate/crop and keyboard routes accessible through sensible disclosure. Clarify loading/retry/source errors.
packets.guard: No external upload/file storage feature or new picker repository. Preserve current props/models/emits so scale work can follow without competing edits.

packets.title: Clarify points, known distance and rescale review
packets.outcome: Put point progress and real distance ahead of exact pixel coordinates, retaining a usable exact alternative. Distinguish intermediate preview from final atomic setup. Show existing rescale impact and unchecked-until-chosen acknowledgement; preserve back/cancel/retry drafts.
packets.guard: No calibration math, transformed point-space, original file, rescale scope or write-boundary changes. ReferencePreview is read-only unless a separately reviewed defect requires it.

packets.title: Adapt the bottom taskbar and current-task guidance
packets.outcome: Keep bottom placement and shared Select/Pan. Plan exposes layout Add; Renovate exposes eligible existing work/context actions. Synchronize outcome-specific completion, busy/invalid state and whole-task Cancel across banner/Details. Use shared state rather than duplicate logic.
packets.guard: No new actions for unsupported targets, broad root edit, command dispatch duplication or cancellation of in-flight writes. Submit root wiring needs to integrator before final checks.

packets.title: Make overlapping targets understandable
packets.outcome: First validate the current visible list/context route. If U4 adoption is recorded, expose a named chooser using current candidates; otherwise improve current guidance only and document the chooser disposition. Keep kind/context/current target and keyboard dismissal clear.
packets.guard: Conditional scope is not permission to invent hit rules, nesting groups or a new selection model. Locked/hidden/handle rank behavior remains unchanged.

packets.title: Polish existing precision and snap feedback
packets.outcome: Make eligible dimensions legible/editable with explicit preview/apply/cancel and clear room/wall impact. Distinguish snap enabled from acquired target; avoid label/handle/taskbar overlap in representative zooms.
packets.guard: No new snapping algorithm, dimension math, room-wall linkage or coordinate editor restoration. Route arbitrary-corner access decisions to I00 rather than silently redesigning.

packets.title: Clarify opening identity and host-relative properties
packets.outcome: Present Door/window/opening identity, real host context and current supported width/height/offset controls in a readable order. Keep hinge/swing secondary and explicit renovation route. Preserve room-less context.
packets.guard: No Door Rename invention, unattached openings, changed offset meaning or host reassignment logic. Verify exact current action names and retain validation.

packets.title: Explain copied scope and direct Paste recovery
packets.outcome: Add bounded presentation feedback over actual snapshot/result counts, target floor and excluded renovation content. Retain direct Paste and one undoable result. Reuse existing notice/Details components; request any shared composition update from integrator.
packets.guard: Direct Paste and keyboard routing already exist: do not rebuild them. No formats, OS clipboard, dependency closure, new preview lifecycle, domain or history changes.

packets.title: Make draft, saving and recovery state truthful
packets.outcome: Render draft versus committed status, Saving, saved-but-stale and unconfirmed/failed outcomes with correct available read/recovery actions. Keep messages perceivable without flooding speech. Remove irrelevant generic reference-scale warnings using truthful current state.
packets.guard: Do not make a read retry replay a write or conflate rollback with unknown save outcome. Preserve original draft target and all failure-category guards.

packets.title: Prevent accidental geometry editing in Renovate
packets.outcome: Hide geometry handles and guard pointer/keyboard mutation entrances in default Renovate while keeping selection/pan/navigation and eligible renovation actions. Edit layout enters Plan deliberately. Preserve existing draft confirmation, busy guard and Review-return snapshot.
packets.guard: CSS-only hiding is insufficient. No source schemas/history rewrite. If guard must move into SelectTool/root, integrator owns that explicit extension and reruns all input boundaries.

packets.title: Verify dark, narrow, keyboard and accessibility consistency
packets.outcome: Capture selected hybrid tasks in connected harness, dark/light/German/narrow and actual boundary widths; measure contrast/targets/focus where claimed. Exercise keyboard/non-drag paths. Produce file/criterion-specific findings for owners, and verify corrected results.
packets.guard: Verification packet owns new report/tests only; route production fixes back to their owners rather than a global CSS override. Screen-reader/native/user testing cannot be claimed from axe/screenshots.

packets.title: Integrate final code and record native release evidence
packets.outcome: Reconcile only approved shared wiring/import/locale requests and remove superseded conflicting style declarations. Verify final integrated tree, CI and disposable native-vault journeys: reopen, PDF, two leaves, focus and recovery. Record any blocked human/AT checks honestly.
packets.guard: No feature expansion or silent merging of unknown changes. Run npm run check only on final integration, after relevant subsets; never run concurrent heavy gates in one checkout.

packets.title: Align help and collect novice acceptance evidence
packets.outcome: Update current visible routes in user help and relevant cases with dated amendments, then prepare scorecards/recruitment-ready protocol. Record actual user/AT results only when human sessions occur. Keep separate counts for first-use, mode comprehension and secondary tasks.
packets.guard: No fabricated participant data or replacing native checks with docs. This model can prepare/synthesize records; a human-run study and product release decision remain required.

packets.title: Resolve the conditional non-drag corner-editing gap
read: docs/issues/Vertex editing has no keyboard path.md
packets.outcome: Follow the I00 decision for an understandable keyboard and non-drag route to existing arbitrary-corner edits. If adopted, expose only that approved route over current geometry commands and verify pointer/keyboard equivalence. If explicitly deferred, record the exact unsupported task/criterion and release consequence; do not imply the removed coordinate form still solves it.
packets.guard: Conditional interaction design must be concrete before coding. Do not automatically restore the rejected coordinate dialog, create a new geometry schema, expand to CAD features or change Renovate mutation guard. This is serialized after I14 because both own InteractionLayer.
